title: EgoInstruct: An Egocentric Video Dataset of Face-to-face Instructional Interactions with Multi-modal LLM Benchmarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical and procedural tasks like furniture assembly and camera maintenance. It evaluates multi-modal LLMs on their ability to segment steps and classify conversation states in instructional videos, with no evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
